mapper.sql: select p.*, c.name as category_name from pet p left join pet_category c on p.category_id = c.id
mapper.insert: insert into pet (name, category_id, breed, gender, age, vaccine, sterilization, description, detail, cover_img, images, status, source, review_status, create_user_id, create_time) values (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{breed}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{vaccine}, #{sterilization}, #{description}, #{detail}, #{coverImg}, #{images}, #{status}, #{source}, #{reviewStatus}, #{createUserId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select:
where p.review_status = '已通过' and p.status in ('待领养', '领养中')
and p.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and p.category_id = #{categoryId}
order by p.create_time desc
mapper.update: update pet set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update pet set review_status = #{reviewStatus} where id = #{id}
